notes: Parker & Dubberstein (1942, p. 21) note that Babylonian dates of Antiochus IV and Antiochus V cannot be separated; reign bounds here rest on the King List.
title: Seleucid king

start_window.basis: Accession in Ulûlu of Seleucid year 137 (BM 35603 rev. 9–10); Ulûlu of that year falls in August–September 175 BC (month-level; exact day not taken from the OCR tables).

end_window.basis: His death was reported in Babylon in Kislîmu of Seleucid year 148 (BM 35603 rev. 14); year 148 began 28 Mar 164 (Parker & Dubberstein), so Kislîmu ≈ late Nov – Dec 164. The death itself preceded the report; window opens 1 Sep 164. 1 Macc 6:16 gives year 149 on the Macedonian-reckoned era.
